    # The four 4x4 panels are separated by columns of 3. Combine their
    # occupied cells, resolving overlaps in the order 9 > 4 > 8 > 5.
    panels = (0, 5, 10, 15)
    priority = {5: 1, 8: 2, 4: 3, 9: 4}
